title: Flipkart Product Scraper
description: Extract product listings from Flipkart.com using either a category/search URL or a keyword, with optional sorting.

startUrl.title: Flipkart URL
startUrl.description: Optional Flipkart category or search URL. Use this or keyword, not both; keyword takes priority if both are supplied.

keyword.title: Keyword Search
keyword.description: Optional keyword search. Use this or startUrl, not both; keyword takes priority if both are supplied.

results_wanted.title: Maximum Products
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to extract.

proxyConfiguration.title: Optional Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Leave disabled unless you explicitly want to route requests through a proxy.
